decks.notes: This deck revolves around the strategy of filling your graveyard with powerful creatures and then utilizing various cards to bring them onto the battlefield rapidly. By using cards like Ichorid, Golgari Thug, and Stinkweed Imp, you can trigger abilities that allow you to return creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield. Cards like Serum Powder and Bazaar of Baghdad help you dig through your deck and put cards into your graveyard quickly. Additionally, cards like Narcomoeba and Prized Amalgam have abilities that allow them to enter the battlefield directly from the graveyard. The aim is to overwhelm your opponent with a constant stream of powerful creatures, ultimately leading to victory.

This deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures like Hollow One, Vengevine, and Hogaak while disrupting their game plan with cards like Collector Ouphe and Force of Vigor. The key strategy is to quickly fill up the graveyard with cards like Bazaar of Baghdad and Serum Powder to power out powerful threats early in the game, taking advantage of the mana acceleration from cards like Gaea's Cradle. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Chalice of the Void and Strip Mine to disrupt the opponent's game plan.

This deck focuses on aggressive play, aiming to quickly and efficiently deal damage to the opponent. It utilizes cards that allow for card advantage, such as Ancestral Recall and Ponder, to maintain a strong hand. The deck also includes disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Mental Misstep to hinder the opponent's strategy. The inclusion of the companion Lurrus of the Dream-Den adds recursion and allows for certain cards to be played from the graveyard. Overall, the deck seeks to maintain board presence while disrupting the opponent's game plan and utilizing various card advantage strategies.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize artifact mana acceleration along with disruptive cards like Null Rod and Sphere of Resistance to slow down the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to capitalize on mana denial through cards like Wasteland and Strip Mine, while generating advantage through Urza's Saga and Golos, Tireless Pilgrim to put pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes powerful threats like Nettlecyst and Stonecoil Serpent to close out games quickly, along with versatile cards like Phyrexian Revoker to disrupt the opponent's key cards.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan through aggressive creatures with disruptive abilities, known as hatebears. By playing cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Chancellor of the Annex, the deck aims to slow down the opponent's spells and prevent them from executing their strategies efficiently. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Trinisphere and Wasteland further disrupt the opponent's resources, while also deploying aggressive threats like Archon of Emeria to apply pressure and close out the game quickly. The deck combines aggressive creatures with disruptive elements to control the game and secure a victory.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's resources while putting pressure on them with efficient creatures like Tarmogoyf and Deathrite Shaman. It also utilizes powerful spells like Force of Will and Demonic Tutor to control the game and search for key cards. The inclusion of disruptive creatures like Collector Ouphe and Oko, Thief of Crowns adds another layer of disruption to the strategy. Additionally, the deck has access to strong card draw and interaction with cards like Ancestral Recall and Force of Negation to maintain board presence and advantage.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo involving Time Vault and Voltaic Key/Metalworker in order to take extra turns and ultimately win the game. It utilizes fast mana and powerful tutors to quickly find and set up the combo pieces. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Thoughtseize to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's plans. Additionally, cards like Mystical Tutor and Demonic Tutor provide additional search options to find key combo pieces. The deck aims to win quickly and efficiently through its combo strategy.

The key concept of this deck is to apply aggressive pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan. The deck achieves this by combining efficient creatures like Tarmogoyf and Deathrite Shaman with disruptive elements such as Lavinia, Azorius Renegade and Collector Ouphe. The deck also includes a suite of powerful counterspells like Force of Will and Mental Misstep to protect its creatures and disrupt the opponent's spells. Additionally, the deck utilizes card draw spells like Ancestral Recall and Treasure Cruise to maintain a steady stream of resources. Overall, the deck aims to quickly establish a dominant position on the board and overwhelm the opponent's defenses.

This deck focuses on maximizing value through efficient spells, resource denial, and powerful threats on the board. By utilizing a mix of powerful cards like Ancestral Recall, Force of Will, and Tarmogoyf, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent while applying pressure through aggressive creatures. With versatile removal options such as Assassin's Trophy and Force of Vigor, the deck can handle a variety of threats. By incorporating Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion, the deck gains additional resilience and consistency in the late game, ensuring a strong and adaptable game plan.

This deck aims to disrupt the opponent's mana base and slow down their game plan with cards like Wasteland, Sphere of Resistance, and Null Rod, while also deploying aggressive artifact creatures like Mishra's Workshop and Foundry Inspector to quickly close out the game. Crucible of Worlds and Ghost Quarter provide additional disruption and Strip Mine can further punish opponent's lands. The deck's goal is to overload the opponent with artifact threats and keep them on the back foot throughout the game.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through counter spells, card advantage, and key artifacts like Time Vault and Bolas's Citadel. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while generating card advantage and using powerful cards like Narset, Parter of Veils, and Opposition Agent to further control the game. It also has a strong mana base with various fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistent mana production. By controlling the game and out-valuing the opponent, the deck aims to secure victory through overwhelming card advantage and strategic plays.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly assemble a powerful board state by using artifacts to ramp and disrupt your opponent's strategy. By utilizing cards like Mishra's Workshop and Sol Ring, you can accelerate your mana production and cast powerful threats like Wurmcoil Engine and Karn, the Great Creator. The inclusion of disruptive artifacts like Chalice of the Void and Thorn of Amethyst can help slow down your opponent while you establish dominance on the battlefield. With the ability to generate mana and play powerful artifacts, this deck aims to overwhelm your opponent with an aggressive strategy.

The deck focuses on quickly playing powerful artifacts and utility lands to disrupt your opponent's game plan while ramping up your own resources. By utilizing the MUD archetype, you can overwhelm your opponent with a combination of efficient threats, disruptive elements, and potent synergies. The deck aims to control the board with permanents like Sphere of Resistance and Trinisphere, while also generating value with cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Golos, Tireless Pilgrim. This aggressive strategy is supported by the deck's ability to lock down the opponent's resources and capitalize on its own powerful artifacts.

This Vintage 1 vs 1 Aggro - Hatebear deck focuses on disrupting opponent's strategies with hate cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Archon of Emeria, while also ramping up mana with fast mana rocks like Moxen and Chrome Mox. The deck aims to control the board with creatures like Chancellor of the Annex and Anointed Peacekeeper, while also utilizing disruptive spells like Chalice of the Void and Trinisphere. The inclusion of Strip Mine and Wasteland provides additional disruption to the opponent's mana base, making it difficult for them to execute their game plan effectively.

This deck focuses on utilizing powerful cards like Ancestral Recall and Time Walk to gain card advantage and tempo advantage. It also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Lavinia, Azorius Renegade to control the opponent's plays. The deck aims to be aggressive with creatures like Orcish Bowmasters while also having a strong control element with cards like Swords to Plowshares and countermagic. The inclusion of the companion Lurrus of the Dream-Den provides additional value by allowing you to reuse key cards from your graveyard.

The deck's primary focus is to utilize the combo potential of Underworld Breach to fuel powerful spells and abilities that allow for explosive plays and potential game-winning sequences. By utilizing cards like Tinker, Brainstorm, and Time Walk in combination with powerful artifacts like Black Lotus and Moxen, the deck aims to quickly assemble a winning board state. The inclusion of various counter spells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce help protect the combo pieces, while additional tutor effects like Mystical Tutor and Vampiric Tutor assist in finding key cards needed for the combo to succeed.
